source_instruction: i am looking for winter warm ankle boots for women. my size is 7.5.
query: Ugh, I spent my whole walk over here fuming because the barista at the corner café completely messed up my oat milk latte this morning—they added vanilla syrup when I explicitly asked for no sweetener, and it was so scalding I burned my tongue the second I took a sip. Then I missed the crosswalk light because a group of tourists stopped right in the middle of the sidewalk to take photos of a random squirrel climbing a fire hydrant, so I had to wait an extra three minutes just to get across the street. I also just realized I left my favorite lip balm in the pocket of the jacket I dropped off at the dry cleaner yesterday, and I’m already kicking myself because that stuff was basically impossible to find in stock the last time I bought it. Anyway, can you help me look for women’s flats that are summer breathable, come in a size 7.5, and don’t cost more than $30?
